limitations.note: Tying ready high changed reset and startup behavior: the original and reference keep ready low through reset until the first rising edge after release, so the rewrite can accept a bit one edge earlier.
The rewrite registered `valid_b` but also gated its assertion on `valid_a`, whereas the reference registers `cnt == 5` even when the sixth input bit is stalled.

The test exercised a stall after five bits but expected `valid_b` to stay low, and its reset checks likewise expected ready to stay high, so it confirmed the rewrite’s assumptions rather than catching either mismatch.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire combined edit-and-test invocation, so both parts had to be submitted again.
The Git status check produced no useful information because the workspace was not a Git repository.
